evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `_owned_work` still only requires the cgroup to be empty (`main_pid == 0` and no pids) and then returns `_jobs_for([UNIT, TIMER])` without requiring that observation to succeed or be empty. A pending service start job can therefore be reported but not rejected, so the drain/boundary check can accept an empty cgroup while owned work is still queued. This is an ordinary correctness repair in the existing drain check, not a new requirement.
